claim_title: Medium chain triglycerides (MCT) oil consumption contributes to weight loss
caption: **MCT oil and weight loss.** Just one small study was reviewed, where overweight adults using MCT oil instead of olive oil in a calorie-restricted diet lost about 1.7 kg more over 16 weeks. But the result **does not hold up once the many measurements are properly corrected for**, over a third of participants dropped out, and MCT was only tested alongside a structured diet — not on its own. The MCT group also lost more lean muscle, so the evidence is too weak to draw a conclusion.
subtitle: One small study showed a modest effect that does not survive proper correction.
